title: World Bloom — All Ways Jump! With You — Episode2 Holding On to Hope

meta.Event Outline: Just when MORE MORE JUMP! has settled in to their lives as Lumina Grand Prix contestants, they notice something wrong with the tree in their SEKAI. Before they know it, the girls find themselves in a world where the four of them never met.

rows.Speaker: Girl A
rows.Line:
Hey, are you feeling okay?
There's a ton of people here, so you gotta be careful, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Girl B
rows.Line: Also, you dropped some of your show flyers. C'mon, lemme help you pick them up.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh... That's right! I was passing out flyers!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Our show's just around the corner, so we gotta attract as many people as we can to come and watch!

rows.Speaker: Girl B
rows.Line: Wait, did you forget what you were doing?

rows.Speaker: Girl A
rows.Line:
Are you really sure you're okay?
If you aren't feeling well, then we could help you with your quota.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, I'm okay!
I promise to make up for spacing out by going full power from here!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hello! We're Pop☆Drop, and we're doing a show next week! Come and watch us if you're interested!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We promise to fill you with lots of encouraging energy! We'd really appreciate your support!

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: No, never heard of them. They're probably underground idols, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, our group's concept involves giving everybody a big boost of energy and—

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: Yikes, she's trying to talk to us. Let's get outta here.

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Member A
rows.Line: How long is this gonna last?

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Member A
rows.Line: We debuted a year ago, but we're still having trouble attracting guests. Even when we do perform on stage, the more popular members always end up overshadowing us.

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Member B
rows.Line: That's on top of our agency playing favorites. While we're here passing out flyers, the select group is doing that magazine interview today, right?

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Member A
rows.Line:
To be fair, it is a free magazine...
*Sigh*
Is this really worth the effort?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(I get what they're saying.
I also worry sometimes that nothing is gonna change no matter how hard I try.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's true that not many people are coming to see us at the moment...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But we'll be performing in front of big crowds someday, as long as we don't give up!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, let's keep trying our best!

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Member A
rows.Line:
Yeah, but when's that gonna be...?
We've invested all this energy already and gotten nothing in return...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Tomorrow will always be a better day.

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Member B
rows.Line: Haha. You always say that, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Member A
rows.Line:
But yeah, you're right...
Thanks. I feel a little better now.

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Member A
rows.Line: Alright, let's do our best to hand out the rest of these flyers!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Thank goodness I was able to cheer them up!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I'm also feeling a little better now as a result.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (It just goes to show how amazing Haruka's words are. Even now, they're able to cheer people up like this.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I was so shocked when I first heard that she'd be retiring from being an idol, but...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I managed to get here just in time. But who can blame me for cutting it a little close today?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(I mean, I did it...!
I finally passed an audition!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Those forty-nine other times, there were times I thought to myself that it was never going to happen...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But I have Haruka to thank for pushing me to not give up. I owe her so much!)

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Minori! Did you see the news?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I made the decision to pay it forward by taking the hope she gave me and spreading it to more people!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (In order to get even just a little bit closer to the idol that Haruka was.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Please come and see our show!
We absolutely promise to blow you away!

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Lead
rows.Line:
Thanks, you guys!
What did you all think of today's show?

rows.Speaker: Pop☆Drop Fan
rows.Line: You shined brighter than everyone else in the world again today, Rittan!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Wow...! They're waving around their glow sticks like crazy!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (How many are in my color? Let's see...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness...!
My usual fans all came back again today...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But that number hasn't increased since we debuted...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(No, I shouldn't think that.
I have fans who've been cheering for me this past year. That alone makes me really happy!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (If I'm gonna spread hope to lots and lots of people the way Haruka did...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Then I've gotta keep trying harder and harder...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (As I am now, I can't get lots of people to look my way or spread hope to them the way Haruka could...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But I've decided that I'm going to get better no matter what!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I want to stand on stage, shine in the spotlight and get people to believe in a better tomorrow.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (That's the kind of idol I wanna be...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Uh oh. I think I twisted my ankle a little...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I have to treat this first...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I need to keep trying harder, but I hurt myself by tripping...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Am I ever going to be like her?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
N-No, stop!
Quit being so negative!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
“Tomorrow will always be a better day!”
My goal is to be an idol who conveys that message.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which means I can't give up...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've decided that I'm going to succeed no matter what. I have to keep moving forward until I become that idol...
I'm certain that somebody out there will feel inspired by the way you're always doing your best.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Was someone trying to cheer me up just now...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(But, yes.
As long as I keep trying, then I'm sure...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, dance practice can wait until tomorrow. Today, I'll work on my singing!
